Dialogs.Dialog: Listen... I'm making dinner tonight. Want to come over and eat？ You don't have to force yourself, though.
Come on, of course I'll come.
Really？ Hehe... Then I'll head home after school and wait for you. Come over whenever.
Hehe... I knew you'd say that. I'll get things ready, so see you later.
Today's a bit tough for me... Sorry.
Oh, really... Well, that's fine then.
Wait, isn't this your first time eating at my place？
Yeah, it is. I'm kind of nervous.
It's not your first time here, so come on. Just make yourself at home.
Today, I wanted you to try a dish I recently learned. Well, you'll see what it is when it's ready.
I do have a menu in mind... but if there's something you want to eat, just say the word, okay？
Okay. Then I'll try making a dish I learned recently.
Okay. Since you're here, I'll make something I think you'll like.
Then I think I'll request ▲メニュー▲.
Sorry to keep you waiting. It turned out pretty great if I do say so myself, so you're in for a treat.
Sorry to keep you waiting. Well, give it a try.
Sorry for the wait. I might've... messed it up a little. Don't worry, though, it's still edible.
I tried going for something a little new this time. What do you think？
I put my own spin on it this time.
I tried doing it Rinko-style today, hehe.
Following a recipe is fine, sure, but I think you're only a real cook once you can add your own touch. How is it？
I did something a little different with today's dish. Wonder if you'll be able to tell.
I put some extra thought into the seasoning on this one. Is it to your taste？
I'm pretty confident when it comes to Japanese food. Well, you'll know once you take a bite.
Japanese food might be my best dish lately. Not sure if it matches your tastes, though.
Lately, I've really been nailing the seasoning on Japanese dishes.
Western food covers a lot of ground, but I think I'm pretty good at it.
Lately, I've been feeling pretty confident making Western dishes.
Leave the Western seasoning to me. I know you're gonna love it.
Being able to cook good Chinese food is actually something I'm pretty proud of.
I think Chinese might be my specialty. Go on, try it. You'll see I'm not just bragging, hehe.
Lately whenever I make Chinese food, I get the flavor and oil just right. Maybe I have a knack for it？
I've gotten pretty good at this kind of dish lately. I think the flavor came out great, don't you？
What do you think of having a girlfriend who's good at making dishes like this？ Hehe.
I've gotten pretty good at making stuff like this lately. I bet you'll think it's good, too.
With me cooking, any dish is gonna turn out great.
Lately, everything I make has been turning out great. I'm sure today's dish is good, too.
Maybe I've got a knack for cooking？ Makes me feel like saying my specialty is everything... Hehe.
Man... Japanese food is tough. I'm trying as hard as I can, too... What's it missing？
Sigh... Japanese cooking is so delicate. I did the best I could, though... so give it a try.
My Japanese dishes haven't been turning out right lately... And I worked really hard on this, too.
Listen... I've been having trouble making Western dishes lately. Still, I worked really hard on this, okay？
Western cooking looks simple, but there's a lot to it. Today's dish should at least... taste like I put the effort in, I think.
Western dishes have been giving me a hard time lately. Just know I really gave today's dish my all, okay？
Chinese cooking has so many steps to keep track of... Oh, but I made sure to put plenty of love into every single one.
Some Chinese dishes have pretty unique seasoning, right？ So even if this tastes a little unique... we could just say it's not my fault... No？
Chinese food is... yeah, it really was tough to make.
I've been having a hard time getting this dish right... Still, I tried really hard on it!
Just so you know... I didn't cut any corners on this. If anything, I put way more effort into it than usual...
I did my best making it, but... I don't feel too confident about this dish.
Lately... I've been struggling to get the flavors right no matter what I make. What can I do to make it the way you like？
I'm really not confident in my cooking... I wish someone would invent a seasoning that makes anything taste good.
Why does cooking have to be this hard...？ Still, I worked really hard on it, so you'll eat it, right？
Recognize these dishes？ They're the matching ones you got me. Hehe.
I really like using these dishes. Not that... it's just because we have matching sets or anything.
Man, I'm stuffed. Thanks for the meal!
(What is this...？ I have a strange feeling something good is about to happen.)
So, how was it？ Personally, I feel pretty good about how it turned out.
Alright, let's hear what you thought. I feel pretty confident about today's dish, hehe.
(I'd say it turned out pretty well, didn't it？)
Hey, you're gonna tell me what you thought, right？ I know I nailed it today.
(Well... she didn't mess anything up, at least.)
How was it？ Was it good？
Hey, mind telling me what you thought？
...How was it？ Didn't taste very good, did it？
(She's got 'I messed up' written all over her face...)
...Are you gonna tell me what you thought？ You don't have to if you don't want to.
(Maybe I should just be honest here？)
Makes it kind of hard to say what you thought, huh？
Really？ Yes! I worked pretty hard on it, you know. Hehe♪
Yeah？ Thank goodness. I felt pretty good about how it turned out, though.
Wait, really？ ...I was sure I messed it up. That's almost anticlimactic.
I see. Guess that's a passing grade for now, then.
Hmm. Well, as long as it was okay.
Well, it tasted fine to me.
Really？ Even like that, it's okay with you... Huh.
I guess it wasn't quite to my taste.
Oh... I see. And here I thought it turned out well... Guess I'll have to rethink it.
I think I'd prefer it seasoned a little differently...
Oh, really？ Okay, I'll look into a different way to make it next time.
How do I put it... I don't think it's really... to my taste.
...I see. I kind of figured as much, though. I'll try to do a better job next time.
Hey... Would you rather have some days where we don't do boxed lunches？
You don't have to if it's too much trouble, ▲小早川＊▲, but I really like your boxed lunches.
Really？ Okay, then I'll make it again for you.
It must be a lot of work for you too, ▲小早川＊▲, so I think the cafeteria is fine.
I see. Well, I don't mind making it, but... going to the cafeteria could be fun too.
Hey, what do you usually do for breakfast？
It depends on the day... I just throw something together.
Then want me to come over and make it for you sometime？ I won't force you if you don't want me to, though.
How was breakfast the other day？ If you want... I was thinking I could come make it again.
I think I'll make my own
It'd really help me out if you made breakfast.
For breakfast... I kind of want to make it myself.
Oh... I see. Well, that's fine then.
I've really gotten into baking sweets lately. Do you want to try some too？
Of course I want to try them.
Hehe... Okay. Guess I'll have to make you some next time, then.
Hey... Can I come over and make dinner again？
If you don't mind, ▲小早川＊▲, I'd really appreciate it.
Got it. I'll come over and cook for you soon, so look forward to it.
I want to try making my own food as much as I can...
Oh... Well, that's fine, I guess.
